nodes.label: Frozen Reproducible Gameplay Benchmark
nodes.rationale: The benchmark is designed to make in-character 1820 Irish inference results reproducible enough to drive engine model and provider presets.

nodes.label: SHA-256 Verified Slice Loader
nodes.rationale: Dataset drift must fail loudly instead of silently changing scores.

nodes.label: Local MLX Memory Safety
nodes.rationale: Candidate RAM estimates and reserved headroom prevent a local sweep from exhausting unified memory.

nodes.label: CLAUDE Agent Scope Alias
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md is a filesystem symlink to AGENTS.md and exposes the same benchmark guidance.

nodes.label: Dataset Integrity Manifest
nodes.rationale: Per-slice hashes and a Merkle root make intentional corpus edits auditable and prevent undetected benchmark drift.

nodes.label: Runtime RAM-Cap Kill Switch
nodes.rationale: A hard live-memory ceiling kills mlx_lm.server before an underestimated model can OOM the host and the driving agent session.

nodes.label: Sonnet-Only Judge Invariant
nodes.rationale: A single load-time chokepoint refuses non-subagent or non-Sonnet judge configurations because earlier Qwen judging inflated dialogue scores.

nodes.label: Free-Form and Schema JSON Compliance Probe
nodes.norm_label: free-form and schema json compliance probe

nodes.label: Freshest-Run Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Timestamped artifact families are deduplicated by candidate/provider/split and modification time so stale reruns do not overwrite fresher evidence.

nodes.label: Pending-Judge Visibility
nodes.rationale: Unfinalized bundle rows remain visible but are labeled pending instead of publishing null scores as regressions.

nodes.label: Frozen Dataset Mutation Guard
nodes.rationale: Once frozen, a changed Merkle root requires a new version directory instead of mutating the benchmark in place.

nodes.label: Judgment Cache-Key Contract
nodes.rationale: The NUL-delimited hash of prompt id, response hash, rubric hash, and judge model makes unchanged rejudging a no-op while rubric, model, or response changes invalidate exactly the affected judgments.

nodes.label: Dialogue Reply Cache for Rubric Iteration
nodes.norm_label: dialogue reply cache for rubric iteration

nodes.label: MLX Candidate Fleet Validation
nodes.rationale: Schema checks reject duplicate repositories, missing fields, invalid slots, and unsafe RAM estimates before a model download or server launch.

nodes.label: Cheapest Quality Provider Selection
nodes.rationale: Quality uses the provider minimizing input price plus three times output price because dialogue output tokens dominate spend; performance remains provider-specific.

nodes.label: Runtime-Parity Dialogue Extraction
nodes.rationale: Judges score the dialogue the player sees by mirroring runtime fence, JSON-envelope, delimiter, truncated-JSON recovery, and verbatim fallback behavior.

nodes.label: Pinned-Rubric Judge Graders
nodes.rationale: Every judge-backed grader verifies rubric_sha256 before scoring to turn silent rubric edits into hard failures.

nodes.label: Judge Result JSON Recovery
nodes.rationale: If a judge writes prose-wrapped JSON or fails to create its done file, recover the outer object into the queue so ingest can retry or continue deterministically.

nodes.label: Bench-Bug Zero-Axis Invariant
nodes.rationale: A bench-bug judgment is valid only when every axis and overall are exactly zero, keeping harness failures out of quality means.

nodes.label: MLX Memory Safety Controls
nodes.rationale: Preflight headroom rejects unsafe candidates, while a live sampler can latch a breach and kill the server before host OOM.

nodes.label: Unified Local and Cloud Benchmark Path
nodes.rationale: The local runner invokes the same rundale_bench.py orchestrator used for cloud targets instead of duplicating grading logic.
nodes.norm_label: unified local and cloud benchmark path

nodes.label: Hugging Face Candidate Preflight
nodes.rationale: Multimodal repositories and repositories without a chat template are rejected because text-only mlx_lm serving or raw prompt formatting would produce invalid benchmark evidence.

nodes.label: Score-Gated Tier Promotion Funnel
nodes.rationale: Promotion requires both an overall threshold and every dialogue axis above its floor, with explicit include and exclude overrides.

nodes.label: Sonnet-Only Judge Chokepoint
nodes.rationale: Every judge-loading path refuses non-Claude-subagent, non-Sonnet-4.6, or API-key-bearing configurations.

nodes.label: Pending-Judge Null Semantics
nodes.rationale: When bundles remain unjudged, score fields become null and pending_judge is set so incomplete results cannot masquerade as real zero scores.

nodes.label: V1 Six-Slice Benchmark
nodes.rationale: A full v1 dev run evaluates intent classification, in-character dialogue, reactions, Tier 2 simulation, Tier 3 simulation, and Gaeilge fluency under one target and cost envelope.

nodes.label: Intent Classification Slice
nodes.rationale: Intent performance is summarized through record count, exact label-match rate, mean score, and parse errors.

nodes.label: Five-Axis Dialogue Slice
nodes.rationale: Dialogue is judged on character, authenticity, language, responsiveness, and craft, with bench bugs and judge failures separated from scored records.

nodes.label: Reaction Quality Slice
nodes.rationale: Reaction outputs are scored for in-character behavior while separately tracking bench bugs, judge failures, and runtime errors.

nodes.label: Tier 2 Simulation Slice
nodes.rationale: Tier 2 simulation reports schema-validity rate and judged plausibility while excluding bench-bug records from the quality mean.

nodes.label: Tier 3 Simulation Slice
nodes.rationale: Tier 3 simulation uses the same schema-validity and judge accounting structure on a more demanding simulation task.

nodes.label: Gaeilge Fluency Slice
nodes.rationale: Gaeilge evaluation separates fluency, grammar, idiom, task fulfillment, and English leakage, with an overall mean and explicit judge provenance.

nodes.label: Yi Structured-Output Failures
nodes.rationale: The model commonly emitted a valid-looking JSON value followed by additional content, causing eight Extra data parser errors; two other records timed out.

nodes.label: Gemma MLX Endpoint 404 Failure
nodes.rationale: The dialogue, intent, and reaction artifacts all hit HTTP 404 before any model call was counted, indicating endpoint readiness or routing failure rather than measured model quality.

nodes.label: Qwen3.7 Max Balanced Quality Peak
nodes.rationale: Within these assigned full-suite runs, Qwen3.7 Max uniquely combines perfect dialogue and reaction scores with strong intent, Tier 2, Tier 3, and Gaeilge results instead of excelling on only one slice.

nodes.label: Qwen3.7 Max Tier-3 Simulation Run 1
nodes.rationale: The first ten-record development run reached 0.70 schema validity and 0.70 mean score, with three HTTP 500 failures.

nodes.label: Qwen3.7 Max Tier-3 Simulation Run 2
nodes.rationale: The repeat ten-record development run improved to 0.90 schema validity and 0.90 mean score.

nodes.label: EuroLLM 9B MLX Full Development Sweep
nodes.rationale: A local MLX target was evaluated across intent, dialogue, reaction, tier-2 simulation, tier-3 simulation, and Gaeilge using ten records per slice.

nodes.rationale: Hermetically verifies catalog resolution, pinned Sonnet rubric integrity, caching, bundle queues, ingest behavior, failure handling, skills, and legacy graders.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Tier Funnel Verification
nodes.rationale: Hermetically verifies tier prompt resolution, run and promotion behavior, differential re-judging, and Phase 1 regressions.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Perf-by-Provider Verification
nodes.rationale: Hermetically verifies performance aggregation, provider sweep behavior, result schema, and earlier phases.

nodes.label: Phase 4 Results Website Verification

nodes.rationale: The starter Gaeilge slice is grounded in attributed external corpora rather than invented examples.

nodes.label: Rundale Bench v1-dev Dataset Manifest
nodes.rationale: An unfrozen 309-record manifest tracks development and holdout files across dialogue, Gaeilge, intent, reaction, tier-2 simulation, and tier-3 simulation.

nodes.label: Merkle and SHA-256 Dataset Integrity
nodes.rationale: Each slice records its SHA-256, record count, and byte size beneath a manifest Merkle root so dataset drift is detectable.

nodes.label: Contender-Tier Dialogue Prompt Set
nodes.rationale: Twenty-five core and evenly spaced extended dialogue prompts expand evaluation for models promoted beyond screening.

nodes.label: Gaeilge Fluency Judge Configuration
nodes.rationale: Pins Claude Sonnet 4.6 subagent judging, a rubric hash, and 1-5 axes for fluency, grammar, idiom, task fulfillment, and English leakage.

nodes.label: Strict Gaeilge Judge Protocol
nodes.rationale: Defines conservative six-axis calibration, Irish-specific leakage rules, batch input and output envelopes, and bench-bug handling.

nodes.label: First-Encounter Reaction Judge Configuration
nodes.rationale: Pins Claude Sonnet 4.6 subagent judging and a hashed 1-5 in-character rubric while preserving judge-migration provenance.

nodes.label: Strict Reaction Judge Protocol
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes persona-specific 1820 greetings from generic rural voice and separates harness failures from scoreable weak replies.

nodes.label: NPC Simulation Judge Configuration
nodes.rationale: Pins Claude Sonnet 4.6 subagent judging and a hashed 1-5 plausibility rubric for tier-2 and tier-3 NPC simulation.

nodes.label: Strict Simulation Judge Protocol
nodes.rationale: Scores mood causality, bounded relationship changes, period activity, named-NPC coverage, and location grounding after schema validation.

nodes.label: Dialogue Judge Configuration
nodes.rationale: Pins Claude Sonnet 4.6 subagent judging and the five-axis dialogue rubric hash while keeping HTTP fields only as provenance.

nodes.label: Strict Dialogue Judge Protocol
nodes.rationale: Defines conservative five-axis calibration for Brigid O'Brien dialogue, batched rationales, script checks, refusals, and bench-bug exclusions.

nodes.label: Bench-Bug Detection Protocol
nodes.rationale: Blank, planning, format-meta, and truncated-meta outputs are scored zero and excluded as harness failures rather than model-quality failures.

nodes.label: Performance Measurement Prompt Set
nodes.rationale: Uses one discarded warmup prompt and cycles six short and long dialogue prompts to fill the requested measurement count.

nodes.label: Screen-Tier Dialogue Prompt Set
nodes.rationale: Defines five core dialogue prompts for initial screening, with later phases intended to add two prompts from each other slice.
